primitives.name: Zero-Idle Self-Scheduling Watchdog
primitives.verbatim_quote: Use the `schedule` tool as a recurring watchdog timer so that if any subagent or background command takes time, you wake up automatically and continue draining `WORK-QUEUE.jsonl` all night long.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Q(t): Queue length at time t (integer), \Delta t: Watchdog interval (s), U(t): System utilization (dimensionless, 0..1).
primitives.assumptions: The underlying compute environment supports reliable cron-like scheduling and persistent queue state across agent wake/sleep cycles.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System enters a deadlock or idle state if Q(t) > 0 and U(t) = 0 for any duration exceeding \Delta t.
